newsitem.title: EGYPT: Four killed in family dispute in south Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in family dispute in south Egypt.

text.p: Four Egyptian farmers were killed and nine wounded in a gunfight between two families over a boundary between fields, security sources said on Wednesday.
The fighting took place in Minya province south of Cairo on Tuesday between the Shehabiya and Azaziya families.
Police brought in armoured cars to stop the fighting, arrested 40 people and confiscated some weapons, they said.
The Shehabiyas lost four men killed and five wounded, while four of the Azaziyas were wounded, they added.
